Record Class ManageBooksControl

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
library.controls.ManageBooksControl
public record ManageBooksControl(Repository repository) extends Record
This class provides control logic for managing books, including operations for approving, rejecting, modifying, and deleting books. It uses a repository to perform database transactions and updates related to book management.

  • Method Details

    • approveBook

      public ManageBooksControl.ApproveResult approveBook(Book pending) throws TransactionException
      Approves a pending book and updates the database in one transaction.

      For a pending book without an originalOrModified reference, it becomes published immediately with the current timestamp as its publishing date.

      If the pending book has an originalOrModified reference:

      • When the pending book is temporary, the data of the referenced original/modified book is updated to match the pending book’s summary and content, and the temporary book is removed.
      • When it is not temporary, the publishing date of the referenced book is copied to the pending book, the pending book becomes published, and the old book record is deleted.

      The author of the book (or the original/modified book) receives a notification about the approval outcome.

      Parameters:
      pending - the pending
      Returns:
      the approve result
      Throws:
      TransactionException - the transaction exception

    • rejectBook

      public ManageBooksControl.RejectResult rejectBook(Book pending) throws TransactionException
      Rejects a pending book and updates the database in one transaction.

      For a pending book without an originalOrModified reference, it becomes rejected immediately.

      If the pending book has an originalOrModified reference, the pending record is simply deleted – the referenced original/modified book remains unchanged.

      The author of the book receives a notification about the rejection.

      Parameters:
      pending - the pending book to reject; must be in Book.ApprovalStatus.PENDING state
      Returns:
      a ManageBooksControl.RejectResult indicating success (no failure path is exposed)
      Throws:
      TransactionException - if any database operation fails during the transaction

    • deleteBook

      public ManageBooksControl.DeleteResult deleteBook(Book book, User.Role role) throws TransactionException
      Deletes a book and notifies the author (if not deleted by author) and all borrowers.

      Before deleting the book, it retrieves all borrows associated with the book. It then removes each borrow record from the database.

      After removing the borrows, it notifies the author and all borrowers about the deletion of the book.

      Parameters:
      book - the book to delete; must exist in the database
      role - the role
      Returns:
      a ManageBooksControl.DeleteResult indicating success or failure
      Throws:
      TransactionException - if any database operation fails during the transaction
